the genetic base of forage quality in alfalfa under water deficit.
the genetic basis of alfalfa forage quality in water deficit conditions.
the genetic basis of phenotypic variations of alfalfa forage quality traits and their responses to different water deficit treatments.

the genetic control of forage quality under water deficit in alfalfa is highly complex and is dependent to water stress.
alfalfa quality traits are dependent to water availability and the genetic control is dependent to the level of stress.
the genetic base of the variation in forage quality traits is complex.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the genetic basis of phenotypic plasticity of forage quality in alfalfa under water deficit is complex and dependent to the stress level.

The main takeaway from our work is that
alfalfa has genetic potential to improve forage quality while enhancing drought tolerance, but that the genetic controls for foraging quality traits are dependent to the level of water deficit.
alfalfa forage quality is a complex trait that is influenced by multiple genetic loci and the expression of these loci is dependent on the level of water deficit.
the genetic control of quality traits is dependent to the levels and duration of water deficit.
